reasons: Seedance 2.0 Standard is the serious final/reference spine.
The user explicitly selected board-to-video, so create a GPT Image 2 control plate before motion.
route.capability_source: PixVerse CLI video/reference help and supported-model table

tasks.label: explicit user-approved visual control plate
tasks.cmd: pixverse create image --model gpt-image-2.0 --quality 1080p --aspect-ratio 1:1 --detail-level medium --prompt 'Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: locked opening still for a browser game prop. Scene/backdrop: an empty after-hours amusement-park service nook, dark warm burgundy-to-amber gradient, no visible architecture competing with the object. Subject: a single late-1980s cotton-candy machine, front three-quarter view, centered and fully visible, compact cream enamel body with deep burgundy lower trim, brushed aluminum bowl, dark inner spinner, small amber pilot lamp, transparent sugar hopper with a little pink sugar, simple wooden serving stick resting at the front. Style/medium: tactile practical product plate, cinematic analog-horror game art, believable worn materials, not glossy modern 3D. Composition/framing: square 1:1, eye-level, generous breathing room around the full machine, stable silhouette suitable for a responsive web card. Lighting/mood: warm carnival bulbs outside frame, faint cold dusk edge light, quiet and slightly wrong. Color palette: aged ivory, oxidized aluminum, burgundy, tobacco brown, faded cotton-candy pink, amber. Materials/textures: scuffed enamel, fine brushed metal, translucent glass, small dust and use marks. Text (verbatim): none. Constraints: no people, hands, faces, mascots, animals, logos, readable labels, UI, watermark; keep the whole machine inside the frame and the bowl horizontal. Avoid: floating parts, melted geometry, giant cotton candy, candy-store styling, sterile showroom gloss.'

tasks.label: final motion render
tasks.cmd: pixverse create reference --model seedance-2.0-standard --quality 1080p --duration 6 --aspect-ratio 1:1 --images {{board.path}} --no-audio --prompt 'Use the reference still as the exact opening composition and preserve the machine silhouette, camera position, lighting, and materials. Create one restrained six-second seamless-feeling object-only loop for a browser game: the amber pilot lamp wakes, the inner spinner rotates with subtle mechanical vibration, fine pink sugar threads begin collecting around the wooden stick and gradually become a small airy cotton-candy puff. Keep the camera locked; no zoom, pan, or reframing. End on a stable full-cotton state that remains readable as the same machine. No people, hands, faces, mascots, animals, logos, readable text, UI, watermark, sparks, smoke, dramatic effects, or background music. Silent picture; existing website SFX will supply the machine sound.'
